curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42076-1-1.pdf (the truck is steps 1-58, the hovercraft from step 59 on; its functions on pages 150-151)

functions.does: Pushed along, the hovercraft's hidden wheels underneath spin both propellers at the stern: a long shaft runs back to a cross shaft, and bevel gears take the drive up each propeller pod's upright shaft and round to the propeller.
functions.source: book: steps 24-49 (the wheels and shafts underneath), 200-203 (the propeller pods); page 151 (bottom right photo, the push arrow and the propellers turning)

functions.does: The black gear on top at the stern steers: it swings both propeller pods together, and the hidden wheels under the stern steer with them, so the hovercraft turns as it's pushed.
functions.source: book: steps 34-49 (the steering wheels underneath), 200-203 (the pods and their link bar); page 151 (top right photo, the arrows on the gear and on both pods)

functions.does: Either gear on a yellow upright shaft on the deck beside the bow lowers and raises the ramp at the bow: bevel gears and a cross shaft under the deck tie the two together, and each turns a linear actuator through a universal joint.
functions.source: book: steps 87, 134-140 (the knobs and cross shaft), 187-190 (the actuators and ramp); page 150 (bottom left photo, the arrow on the ramp)

functions.does: The black gear on the carriage at the top of the red gantry raises and lowers the white bridge: an 8 tooth gear behind it climbs the tall black rack the bridge stands on.
functions.source: book: steps 210-217 (the carriage, its gears and the rack; the inset on page 135); page 150 (top left photo, the arrows on the gear and the rack)
functions.note: the carriage has a second black gear, p705, on a second 8 tooth gear; which of the two drives the rack is unsure

functions.does: The bridge, on its carriage, slides from side to side along the gantry's black top beam.
functions.source: book: page 150 (top middle photo, the arrows on the bridge)

functions.does: The truck: the black gear on its cab roof steers its front wheels.
functions.source: book: steps 1-20 (the steering), page 151 (top middle photo, the arrows on the roof gear and the front wheel)

functions.does: The truck's rear axle swings up and down, sprung by a shock absorber.
functions.source: book: page 151 (top middle photo, the arrow on the rear wheel); which steps build it is inferred
functions.note: the spring only matters under the truck's weight; the axle's travel is what's checked

functions.does: The truck's four wheels roll; it can drive up the ramp onto the deck.
The rotors in the two red fans on deck spin freely.
functions.source: inferred: steps 204-206 fit each rotor on a pin; the book draws no arrow on them

questions.question: Which knob does which, where the book doesn't label them?
